name: L5 prospective validation on three unexamined M1 held-out calibration sessions
scope: Three new public held-OUT calibration sessions 20121004/17/24. Same macaque, new dates. Forward whole-trial split within each acquired session; not private benchmark evaluation or human transfer.
prior_information: Earlier M1 source days and L5 development outcomes viewed. Held-in minival overlap discovered before any model score and validation cancelled; files reuse training prefixes. New held-out session masks/timestamps/trial starts and shapes only inspected, no neural/target values. Linear primary selected on source interpretability grounds; softplus secondary. V1 initialization configuration originated in H1 development.
prerequisite: Root record allow_heldout_m1 true, exact source encoder/evaluate/audit/protocol/capacity hashes. Earlier held-IN minival protocol execution is revoked.

data.files: All three dates without outcome exclusions

support_and_query.support: FIRST320 eligible rows of each held-out calibration file. Fits a fresh head for every frozen bank. Support spans first3 trials; remaining eligible rows in third trial are unused.
support_and_query.query: Every eligible row of all subsequent WHOLE trials with ID strictly after the last support row trial. Exactly7 later trials per file, 914/905/895 query bins. No query labels/activity in support fits or bank adaptation.
support_and_query.chronology: Forward split within same file, verified by absolute bin and trial indices. Query feature history resets at each trial, so no support/query context overlap. New dates remain one animal. Audit exact25-bin neural blocks against all four earlier source recordings.
support_and_query.features: Frozen selected source bank; causal25taps, trial/file reset. For capacity reference25features per neuron; otherwise5. Earlier support-trial spikes supply unlabelled history only.
support_and_query.normalization: Supportmean/stdwithfixed0.1count-unit floor, per-output targetintercept andonepooledscale; fresh ridgehead eachfile andbank. Mean-normalizedGram exactlysame asL5source.
support_and_query.labels: First320 support selected solely eligibility mask before neural/target values; later whole query trials selected by trial IDs.

primary: Mean weighted R2 across three real-trained LINEAR banks within file, then unweighted mean over THREE dates. Average scores, not predictions.

methods.trained: Everyreal/synthetic/time_shift ×linear/softplus ×3sourcefits, exactday3selectedcheckpoint and320binridge fromL5 evaluate.json. No sourceweightsfine-tuned.
methods.fixed: V1, sqrt-countV1, multiscale,3randombanks, initialsoftplusV1; eachlambda frozen L5day3 selection.
methods.capacity: Full25lag raw/sqrtcount ridge, lambda10 fromindependentlyregistered sourcecapacitydiagnostic.1600Dvs320D explicitunequalcapacity.

selection: All banks/checkpoints/lambda values remain frozen from third source day. No changes from any new held-out outcome, no exclusions or replacement seeds.
metric: Float64 variance-weighted R2 across all16 muscles and every selected future eligible row. Per-muscle R2 and SSE/SST; all three file scores shown.

intervals.unit: Three dates; average the three source-fit scores within date before bootstrap
intervals.interpretation: Conditional descriptive intervals with only3 dates, not population or formal non-inferiority evidence. Exact two-sided signflip minimum .25 for three pairs.

quality_reporting.functional: All3primary realbank predictionsfinitewithnofallback; reportmeanR2andcountfailedfiles/fitseeds. MeanR2>=.10 isdescriptivequalityscreen.
quality_reporting.advance: After independentaudit, recordseparatehumanprotocol/decision. Sourcefunctionalquality/consistency informsjudgment; descriptivebootstrap screensneitherprove norveto crossspeciestransfer. Nohumanscoringunderthisprotocol.

artifacts: data/wacv/xspecies_l5_m1_heldout: protocol/advance/export/source hashes, duplicate audit, exact support/query absolute bins and trial IDs, recording spans, per-bank raw predictions, all file scores, summary and independent audit. Separate data/xspecies/falcon_m1_heldout/000941 cache, never added to old source file glob.
limitations: Offline one-monkey EMG decoding on genuinely unexamined session values; global outer gradients and global ridge head. No private benchmark result, new animal, species conservation or embodied closed-loop claim.
